caption: “Development of the Ostrich Fern,” Plate 6 from The Development of the Ostrich Fern, Douglas Houghton Campbell (Boston: Society of Natural History, April 1887).
alt: A plate of microscope drawings showing the early growth of the ostrich fern, numbered 1 to 15: cell after cell in rounded and elongated clusters, cross-sections of tissue, and a tiny young fern rising from its prothallus.
bibliography: Campbell, Douglas Houghton. "Development of the Ostrich Fern." Plate 6, The Development of the Ostrich Fern, Boston Society of Natural History, 1887.

edition.title: The Development of the Ostrich Fern
